description: Source code for the opt3001 light sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write, initialization, and data fetching functions.

methods.name: opt3001_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the OPT3001 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: opt3001_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the OPT3001 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: opt3001_reg_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register on the OPT3001 sensor.

methods.name: opt3001_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new light measurement sample from the sensor.

methods.name: opt3001_channel_get
methods.description: Converts the raw sample into a sensor_value representing light level in lux.

methods.name: opt3001_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, verifying manufacturer and device IDs, and sets continuous mode.

methods.name: opt3001_init
methods.description: Main initialization function for the sensor device.
